nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Generate natural hand-held product imagery from a person image and target product asset.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the product image. The image must be at most 20 MB and between 385 and 8192 pixels in both width and height.

outputNum.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.

targetMaskUrl.description: Public URL of the black-and-white hand-held area mask. Required because this API accepts custom pose images rather than saved upstream materials.

targetOriginUrl.description: Public URL of the person or hand pose image.

name: nexscope_handheld_product_mockup
title: Handheld Product Mockup API
